briefs.audience: Fictional architectural librarians and material students interested in speculative ceramic surfaces and thermal tactility.
briefs.purpose: Present a conceptual collection of handcrafted-looking ceramic reading objects that helps visitors understand imaginary material choices without claiming commercial products or tests.
constraints: Invent original product-study language without asserting actual manufactured objects, customers or performance measurements.
Make legible editorial pages with thoughtful restrained art direction, responsive navigation and no remote images.
Differentiate this fictional material library from both Arcloom objects and the coastal listening sample.
No live forms, payments, external references or fabricated professional endorsements.

briefs.audience: Imaginary night-walk curators, civic spatial-design students and public-realm storytellers seeking careful mapping narratives.
briefs.purpose: Design an independent fictional atelier identity about observing nighttime routes and making speculative public-space mapping stories without implying physical installations.
constraints: Do not claim real maps, deployed sensors, clients, awards, publications, or actual civic commissions.
Prioritize accessible hierarchy and memorable original verbal identity instead of stock tech graphics.
Allow a coherent high-contrast color system appropriate for nocturnal subject matter.
Do not request location data, tracking, signup information or external network services.

briefs.audience: Imaginary bookbinding graduates, printmaking educators and creative editors exploring experimental paper-folding storytelling.
briefs.purpose: Create a fictional research portfolio of conceptual folded-paper narratives, with compelling editorial language and an original visual direction that can be understood without images.
constraints: All authors, artworks and artifacts are hypothetical research and must never be portrayed as commercial achievements.
Keep the visual voice typographic and distinct from the other two held-out brands.
Maintain good text contrast, meaningful page titles and mobile-friendly static navigation.
Use no user-data collection, external links, arbitrary code, script execution or client testimonials.
